scientific_integrity: The basic headway-squared identity is established prior mathematics. The stated contribution is the exact three-optional-mode correlated scheduling phase boundary and complete optimizer. Finite rational checks supplement, but do not replace, the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Idealized guaranteed-anchor periodic bus service with precisely three optional-service modes and one no-service mode; uniform independent passenger arrivals, unlimited capacity, zero minimum headway. This is a mathematical benchmark, not an empirical operating recommendation. Priority against all possible scheduling literature is not independently established.
title: A sharp co-dispatch transition under three-mode correlated service outages
